cosmic_existential: I am a tiny speck of stardust, temporarily wearing a sweater.
The universe is 13.8 billion years old, which means my minor embarrassing moment yesterday does not matter.
My mistakes are completely invisible from space.
I possess the exact same number of bones as a skeleton. Powerful.
I am hurtling at 67,000 miles per hour through the solar system, even while sitting on this stool.
The sun is basically a giant nuclear furnace, and yet I am currently chilly.

aggressively_positive: I am going to utterly dominate this cup of coffee!

pseudo_profound: To walk forward, one must first lift their foot.
A cup that is half full is also half empty, but mostly, it is just a cup.
The future is exactly where the present goes to hide.
When you close your eyes, you cannot see.
A wet towel is simply a dry towel that has experienced water.
The longest distance between two points is an unread email.
Wherever you go, there you are, unless you are lost.
